title: Nino region SSTs and anomalies by week (OISST)

metadata.cadence: weekly (value is centred on the stated date)
metadata.note: The fastest-moving official ENSO number, and the one press coverage usually quotes. It is unsmoothed and runs well above the seasonal ONI during a warming event, so it must never be compared with an ONI threshold directly. Source column order puts Nino3.4 THIRD, unlike the monthly files. The legacy 1981-2010 file wksst8110.for is frozen at Jan 2021 - do not use it.
